title: Website appears and disappears from Google search results for my brand name – Is this a caching or ranking issue?
summary: Hi everyone, I run an online jewelry brand called Noufera ( https://noufera.com/ ), based in Pakistan. I'm facing a strange issue with Google Search. When I search for "Noufera" , sometimes my website appears in the search results, but sometimes it completely disappears. However: Searching site:noufera.com consistently shows my website. Google Search Console says my homepage is indexed ("URL is on Google"). For the exact query "noufera", Search Console recorded 44 clicks and 226 impressions over the last 3 months. Between October 28 and November 4, it recorded 4 clicks and 31 impressions, all from Pakistan. I've also noticed that sometimes, when I search in Incognito mode, my website appears after refreshing Google, but disappears after another refresh. My website uses WordPress, WooCommerce, Rank Math SEO and LiteSpeed Cache. I've recently updated my homepage heading, SEO title, and Organization schema. My questions: Could this be a Google ranking fluctuation or search data-centre issue? Can LiteSpeed Cache or another caching layer cause this behaviour in Google search results? Why does Google show my website for "Noufera Karachi" but inconsistently for just "Noufera"? What should I investigate before making further SEO changes? I'd appreciate advice from experienced SEO professionals or website owners who have faced something similar. Thank you!   submitted by   /u/noufera [link]   [comments]
